notes.title: WOOOW! The game has more than 5000 players
notes.notes:
WOOOW! The game has more than 5000 players
 
Hello Steam, haven't been here for a long time, we have a lot of news:
 
- more than 5000 players in Bad Boy Simulator
- more than 30 reviews were made about the game on YouTube and TikTok
- in total we scored 14,000,000 views
 
Thank you for your activity, thank you for doing dirty tricks!
 
The main character of the game has become even more reckless and cool. Your antics and love for mischief inspired us to continue the game. BIG QUESTION: making a sequel to Bad Boy Simulator???
 
If you are with us, write in the comments YES!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

notes.title: KILLER UPDATE
notes.notes:
Gameplay:

There are 30 levels in the new class! A system for mixing chemical components is available to you, it is on them that the gameplay is focused.
Place fireworks or a bomb right in the classroom, freeze the teacher and poison, but that's not all!

The old class now also has 30 levels.
Time stopping system updated. Every 10 levels, the ability to stop time will change. From 1 to 10 levels, as before, but from 11 to 20 you cannot just restore time, you have to do dirty tricks.

Also, at the beginning of the level, your energy reserve for stopping time will be at zero. From 21 to 30 levels of filth will give much less opportunity to restore time, this will lead to the fact that you have to switch to stealth mode of the game more. Distract the teacher more and monitor his actions.

Graphics:

New characters! We changed the character models, made them more real and atmospheric.
The interior of the classrooms and the corridor has been changed. Now the card is one, from the chemistry room it will be possible to get into any other that is found in the game.

Other:

New kind of menu on levels.
New main menu, it has become more convenient and interesting.
Also, some bugs and visuals of items have been fixed.

notes.title: New design of locations!
notes.notes:
New interesting design of locations!
The classes will be made in a new design, like the corridor, in which you can now walk, and for each individual level there will be its own menu locker.
We will also add new items to classrooms for students, there will be new backpacks and school supplies.

Also, our team decided to refine and improve the lighting in the game!
Now objects will have shadows and graphical improvements will be added in the form of smoothing objects, the picture will be lighter and softer.
Play and check out the new graphics!

notes.title: New menu in the game
notes.notes:
We now have a cool new menu!
We decided to make the game even more interesting and upgrade the player's school locker. A scanner camera has now been added to the locker, which opens access to the glove and a panel with buttons for selecting a level.
The number of levels has increased and at each of them it will be more difficult and more interesting for you to play. There are new items and the ability to combine them for different dirty tricks that will infuriate the teacher.
Isn't it cool? The menu has become more user-friendly and there will be something new and interesting at each level. Already waiting for an update?

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
GAME PROCESS:

• Sequential access to levels
• We try the gameplay direction, when you do not have all the items on the map, but the level says what items are, so that the gameplay is not in the form of a sandbox (although there is such a level, it is available at the very end), and you have a task ( anger the teacher) and specific methods of achievement are indicated, try until you succeed

CONTROLLERS:

• Now the teleport is always on the right hand (on the oculus: tumbstick up, on Vive: trackpad up)
• Stop time on both hands (the button itself is changed only on the oculus: X. A)

GRAPHIC ARTS:

• Improved lighting, raised image resolution, which should not noticeably affect performance
• Changed the menu (pause, win, loss), called buttons right in the class
• Selection of objects - the whole object is highlighted

Also some bugs fixed
- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
ИГРОВОЙ ПРОЦЕСС:
• Последовательный доступ к уровням
• Мы пробуем геймплейное направление, когда у тебя на карте не все предметы, но на уровне написано, какие предметы есть, чтобы геймплей был не в виде песочницы (хотя такой уровень есть, он доступен в самом конце), а у тебя стоит задача (разозлить училку) и обозначены конкретные методы достижения, пробуй, пока не получится

КОНТРОЛЛЕРЫ:
• Теперь телепорт всегда на правой руке (на oculus: tumbstick up, на Vive: trackpad up)
• Остановка времени на обоих руках (сама кнопка изменена только на oculus: X. A)


ГРАФИКА:
• Улучшено освещение, поднято разрешение картинки, что не должно заметно сказаться на производительности
• Изменено меню (паузы, победы, проигрыша), вызывающееся кнопки прямо в классе
• Выделение объектов - подсвечивается весь объект

Также поправлены некоторые баги

notes.title: Update, Optimization, New items and interactions and Fix Bugs
notes.notes:
Update:

• Introduced management training for HTC Vive

Optimization:

• Reducing polygons from meshes
• Introduction of levels of detail from distance
• Turn off unnecessary shadows and optimize the light

New items and interactions:

• Push pin - can be placed on the teacher's chair
• Chewing gum by chewing, you can glue objects
• Peanut butter - so sticky you could stick someone on
• Turd - now you can eat it, put it under your feet or throw it at a classmate
• Painted blackboard with chalk now makes the teacher angry

Bugs:

• Improved operation of the pause, defeat and victory menus
• More correct operation of the key
• Soap on the board is now more visible
• Smooth movement now has a uniform speed
• The teacher behaves more correctly
• When the board is dirty, the student is called
• And more than 20 minor changes

notes.title: Building a chemistry class!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39352540/50ab1ab4b7c82687f96b0804394dfc74c1be4c55.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39352540/8b82bfadb019f6c2eaedcc73ec58ddccec55d77a.jpg[/img]
The game does not stand still, we draw new classes, add interesting dirty tricks. A chemistry class is currently under development.

We made a high table so that it was convenient to do chemistry, added many flasks, beakers, scales, molecular models, a microscope, a fume hood, a gas canister, a fire extinguisher and a first aid kit. That's not all!

Any ideas on how to piss off a teacher in a chemistry class? Write your suggestions and wait for the news from Bad Boy Simulator 🔥

notes.title: The game now supports HTC VIVE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39352540/eb240e05664e86f8f79db0385258d0959e59f56f.jpg[/img]
We've added controls for HTC vive. This will allow more people to play! We also increased the optimization of the game's performance so that the computer was less loaded, some bugs were fixed.
We added an important part - learning how to manage the game. Now playing is even more enjoyable and easier.

We want to reach a wide audience and hear different opinions and ideas about Bad Boy Simulator. Therefore, the game now supports Oculus Rift and HTC vive. Enjoy, friends! We are waiting for feedback to make the game more interesting and powerful.

Share your opinion and ideas on Bad Boy Simulator directly with the developers
Let's play hide and seek?

notes.title: Dizzying changes before the start
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39352540/33419c188391a01f1bbfe8d787b4368fdca53b64.png[/img]We decided to make our game better before it came out! Yes, yes, we are, running ahead of the steam locomotive.
We decided to do re-dezign right before the start! It's all for a reason. We believe that we must try to the maximum and make improvements for our game here and now.
Now the picture has become much lighter, the colors are brighter, it has become more pleasant to watch, and it is more interesting to play. In our profile, we have already updated all images and will add new videos and screen-shot. And of course, we expect them from you! The game will be released tomorrow! Who will catch the coolest frame in the game?

notes.title: We do the voice acting for our game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39352540/83303857d430f26bef3a176114a568440ceb3dec.png[/img][b]We make all the sounds for the game ourselves![/b]
Yes! It's not a joke! All the voice acting in the game - from laughter to wild anger comes from the voices of our team.
It was fun to voice - we had to work on acting and voice, we are sure that now we can safely go to work on voicing cartoons!ːsteamhappyː
And we hope that you will like our voice acting, let it add to your impressions of the very process of the game!
